title: The Stars Whisper Big Changes for Aquarius
script_text: Aquarius, Air sign, the cosmos ignites sudden breakthroughs that will reshape your social horizons this week. Monday's Sun conjunct Uranus in the 3rd House, fueling your unconventional tech ideas that attract new friends. Tuesday's Mars square Mercury in the 10th House spurs career friction, turbulence for your public image. Mercury retrograde in the 5th House turns romance and creativity into inner reviews. Saturn enters your 2nd House Saturday, demanding fiscal discipline and reshaping income streams, while a Neptune trine adds intuitive clarity. Venus‑Pluto conjunction in the 7th House on Sunday intensifies love, urging deep fear confrontations. Wednesday shines as Venus enters the 5th House, boosting romance and creative confidence. Tuesday is most uneasy, Mars‑Mercury square aggravating career disputes and public missteps. Schedule a mid‑week creative workshop Wednesday, then review finances Saturday to align with Saturn’s structure. Follow for daily updates and deeper astrological guidance.
